draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.82, the 204th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 26th of 28 at WR. He lasted until pick 258, well after his grade rank (204th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 898 receiving yards in 2021, 16th of 28 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 23 career games and 2 starts over 3 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (5th percentile). Played 1 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-4 wide receiver who played: 3 receiving yards against a median of 302, below the norm.
